info.title: LaiShopQuanAo API
info.description: Single-shop storefront. Cookie session authentication and CSRF header from /api/v1/auth/csrf are required for mutations. Money is a decimal string; checkout requires Idempotency-Key. Media providers are intentionally unconfigured.
